review.posthog_relevance: Adds resource cleanup and cancellation support to batch export activities for Azure Blob, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, Redshift, Snowflake, and Workflows, preventing resource leaks and allowing cancellation of in-progress exports.
review.reason: The observed changes demonstrate a substantive, bounded improvement in reliability and resource management. P1.F1.H3, P1.F2.H2, and P1.F3.H2 show the implementation of an `AsyncExitStack` and the registration of a cleanup callback (`producer.stop`) across multiple batch export destinations. This prevents resource leaks when batch export activities are abandoned or the process exits
